enemy-036-deacon-line.note: Twelve individually marked rigid mitre chords, three distinct poses per clip. Median idle chord 117.175083px is the baseline; factors are idle median divided by each clip median. No per-frame bounding box rescaling and no runtime acceptance.

enemy-037-neomorph.note: Manual rigid cranial-dome chord review on the four unchanged 1774x887 masters. The chord runs from the posterior shoulder of the solid smooth cranial dome to the anterior hard-dome tip; dorsal spines, jaw, neck, limbs, tail and global pose bounds are excluded. Three readable side-profile poses were inspected per clip. Factors are post-generation calibration candidates only and imply neither source modification nor visual/runtime acceptance.
